test.create_query: CREATE TABLE range_fij_sales (item_id UInt32, sold_date UInt16, ship_date UInt16, demo_id UInt32, hd_id UInt32, qty UInt16, payload FixedString(128)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE range_fij_inventory (item_id UInt32, inv_date UInt16, wh_id UInt16, qty_on_hand UInt16, payload FixedString(128)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
CREATE TABLE range_fij_date_dim (date_id UInt16, year UInt16, week UInt16) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY date_id
CREATE TABLE range_fij_demo (demo_id UInt32, status UInt8) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY demo_id
CREATE TABLE range_fij_household (hd_id UInt32, potential UInt8) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY hd_id
CREATE TABLE range_fij_warehouse (wh_id UInt16, name String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY wh_id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO range_fij_date_dim SELECT number, 1990 + intDiv(number, 365), number % 53 FROM numbers(3650)
INSERT INTO range_fij_demo SELECT number, number % 50 = 0 FROM numbers(20000)
INSERT INTO range_fij_household SELECT number, number % 50 = 0 FROM numbers(20000)
INSERT INTO range_fij_warehouse SELECT number, toString(number) FROM numbers(50)

INSERT INTO range_fij_sales SELECT number % 400, number % 3650, (number + 10) % 3650, number % 20000, intHash64(number) % 20000, (number % 100) + 1, toFixedString(toString(number), 128) FROM numbers(130000) SETTINGS min_insert_block_size_rows = 10000000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

INSERT INTO range_fij_inventory SELECT number % 400, number % 3650, number % 50, number % 100, toFixedString(toString(number), 128) FROM numbers(130000) SETTINGS min_insert_block_size_rows = 10000000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

SELECT throwIf(count() != 2, 'join_merge_range_filter_into_join: expected 1 active part per fact table') FROM system.parts WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND table IN ('range_fij_sales', 'range_fij_inventory') AND active
test.query: SELECT count() FROM range_fij_sales AS s INNER JOIN range_fij_inventory AS i ON s.item_id = i.item_id INNER JOIN range_fij_date_dim AS d1 ON s.sold_date = d1.date_id INNER JOIN range_fij_date_dim AS d2 ON i.inv_date = d2.date_id INNER JOIN range_fij_date_dim AS d3 ON s.ship_date = d3.date_id INNER JOIN range_fij_demo AS cd ON s.demo_id = cd.demo_id INNER JOIN range_fij_household AS hd ON s.hd_id = hd.hd_id INNER JOIN range_fij_warehouse AS w ON i.wh_id = w.wh_id WHERE d1.week = d2.week AND i.qty_on_hand < s.qty AND d3.date_id > d1.date_id + 5 AND d1.year = 1999 AND cd.status = 1 AND hd.potential = 1 AND sipHash64(s.payload) % 64 != 63 AND sipHash64(i.payload) % 64 != 63

SELECT count() FROM range_fij_sales AS s INNER JOIN range_fij_inventory AS i ON s.item_id = i.item_id INNER JOIN range_fij_date_dim AS d1 ON s.sold_date = d1.date_id INNER JOIN range_fij_demo AS cd ON s.demo_id = cd.demo_id INNER JOIN range_fij_household AS hd ON s.hd_id = hd.hd_id WHERE d1.year = 1999 AND cd.status = 1 AND hd.potential = 1 AND sipHash64(s.payload) % 64 != 63 AND sipHash64(i.payload) % 64 != 63
